metadata.transport: independent processes, localhost DDS, intra-process disabled
metadata.scheduling: single-threaded executor/spin loop; 100 ms blocking wait cap; one message in flight
metadata.rtt_boundary: before request publish through response retrieval, before initiator payload validation
metadata.echo_work: complete sequence/layout/payload validation; Rust view echo borrows the immutable native item through publish_view, historical/C++ echo uses normal typed publish
metadata.throughput_boundary: all measured roundtrips including initiator validation, excludes warmup/discovery/teardown
metadata.api_comparison: explicit borrowed native receive and forwarding API versus historical Rust owned-message API; ordinary typed subscription behavior is unchanged

build_manifest.receive_api_detection: native_views.rs present: subscribe_view and publish_view echo; absent: normal typed receive/publish fallback
build_manifest.benchmark_cfg: --check-cfg=cfg(r2r_bench_native_views); --cfg r2r_bench_native_views only where the view API exists
